note: Merula: IMSLP's Op. 12 numbers follow Ensemble Fitzwilliam's track numbers; L'Aura Soave Cremona numbers its tracks in book order instead. Slice m02: no benchmarks and no cross-listed violin entries (the 34 violin-catalogue entries of Alberti, Bonporti and Veracini are violin-and-continuo duos). Janitsch's Sonata in E minor for oboe d'amore, two violas and continuo (recorded by Die Freitagsakademie) has no page among the candidates and is added without an IMSLP page. Two outOfScope pages were added because their reasons were wrong: Merula's Ciaccona, Op. 12 No. 20 (the opus print names violins) and Molter's Sonata a quadro MWV 9.16 (recorded as a flute quartet by Camerata Bachiensis). Recording evidence is from Deezer and Apple track lists (album ids in sources). String-orchestra question (skipped; no one-to-a-part recording found): Alberti's Sinfonie a quattro Op. 2, Dauvergne's Concerts de simphonies (Concerto Koln, Warner), Pergolesi's Sinfonia in F. Scope questions for the owner: Frescobaldi's four Canzon a due bassi (F 8.15c-8.18c; bass instruments unspecified, recorded on bass violins by Les Basses Reunies/Cocset, Alpha 2004) are skipped as unspecified instruments; Cima's Sonata No. 47 (cornetto and trombone, violin and violone only as the alternative) is skipped under the first-named rule; Cazzati's Op. 35 trumpet sonatas (La Bianchina, La Caprara, La Zambeccari; recorded by Novara, Hyperion, NAR) sit on outOfScope pages as 'trumpet, strings, continuo' and were not added because the part count is unverified; Neri's Op. 2 sonatas a 3 (Concerto Scirocco) are not itemised on IMSLP; Trio Sonnerie's Roman CD (Musica Sveciae 2012) holds six more trio sonatas (BeRI 106, 107, 109, 111, 114, 120) that the census lacks, scoring not checked; La Gioconda's 'Fux: Triopartiten' (Querstand 2011) holds trio partitas that may match Fux K. 324, 340 and 342 but carry no numbers. Matched by key, scoring or duration rather than by number (confidence medium or low): Janitsch's two trio sonatas SA 3440 and SA 3441 (Brilliant 2020; the D major trio there uses a viola, so IMSLP's flute-and-violin D major was dropped), Platti's D major trio, Graun's horn trios (the Musicaphon CD mixes J. G. and K. H. Graun), Fux K. 347 (Harnoncourt), Capricornus's Sonata a 8, Stradella's Sinfonia in A minor, Mancini's two recorder concertos (one self-distributed CD). Quantz QV 2:Anh. works are of doubtful authorship but recorded under his name; the Dynamic CD may use a recorder. IMSLP recording signals that could not be confirmed on Deezer or Apple (Quantz QV 2:28 and 2:35, Fux K. 342 and 353, Platti A major, Cazzati Op. 55, Capricornus Chaconne, Roman BeRI 101, Veracini Fuga, Stradella Sinfonia in F) are skipped as not performed or recorded and could be rechecked on the Naxos Music Library. No composer proposed for exclusion.
